name: Junko
source: Junko is one of the girls that ended up stranded on a deserted island. She was on the cruise for business-related reasons. Junko is the one who comes up with the plans, making her the leader of the group as she doesn't like to be pushed around.
translation: Junko is one of the girls that ended up stranded on a deserted island. She was on the cruise for business-related reasons. Junko is the one who comes up with the plans, making her the leader of the group as she doesn't like to be pushed around.
